discussion_comments.comment_body: I know the agents like to do this - and it's nice to not have 10 arguments - but with the options type it's hard to tell at the callsites which options are not being used/which options have their default value.
Very good idea to consolidate this into one function though
I generally prefer named arguments. The only alternative is to break it up into multiple functions which is really what I want to avoid. In practice most options are not used.
i don't love this, open to suggestions
we could do a `baseURL: resolveBaseUrl(model),` general function, not cloudflare-specific. in case more providers want to be onboarded too

i think it's fine. the only reason we need resolveCloudflareBaseUrl here is due to the substitution. openai-completions.ts has become a mess already anways due to all provider specific "fixes". one more will not hurt much.
AgentSession is public API. Having an internal arg here is not good. Just make it a public argument. Do we want this to be optional? What is the default when omitted?
Updated to public source. Made it optional, defaults to "interactive".

This will wrap the line if the terminal width can't fit the full line. Might be what we want, might not be what we want. Suggests that setWidget should likely be Component based and not string list based.
